ledger.note: 826: independence. The abbey was announced 'at a synod in Paderborn in 815'; 'The first monks arrived in 816'; the monks moved in 822; 'In 826, Corvey became an independent abbey, dedicated to Saint Stephen.' The princely status came 'from the Late Middle Ages': the page gives no year.
1792: prince-bishopric. 'In 1792, Corvey ceased to be a Benedictine abbey and was raised by pope Pius VI to the status of a prince-bishopric.' Entered as a rank step inside one state.

1803: secularised. 'In 1803, the Prince-Bishopric of Corvey was secularized under Napoleonic administration' and 'became briefly part of the Principality of Nassau-Orange-Fulda'; 'While Corvey had ceased to exist as a political state in 1803, it continued to exist as a diocese until 1825.'
